info.title: ReadFlow
info.description: ReadFlow: AI-Powered Document Intelligence Platform API

post.description:
Uploads a document (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD), validates size/type,
stores the raw file, and queues the asynchronous ingestion pipeline.

get.description: Retrieves list of documents with optional filtering by title or collection.

schema.title: Response List Documents Api V1 Documents Get

patch.description: Updates document title or collection assignment.

delete.description: Deletes a document, its chunks, highlights, and underlying storage file.

get.description: Polls real-time document processing progress and status messages.
Retrieves structured page contents and raw text for the reader interface.
Lists indexed semantic chunks for a document.

schema.title: Response Get Document Chunks Api V1 Documents  Document Id  Chunks Get

post.description: Saves a highlighted text passage with color and optional notes.

get.description: Lists all saved highlights for a document.

schema.title: Response List Document Highlights Api V1 Documents  Document Id  Highlights Get

get.description: Lists all collections with their associated document count.

schema.title: Response List Collections Api V1 Collections Get

post.description:
Submits a natural language query against a document or multi-document collection.
Returns a grounded answer with page-level citations.
Generates quick, detailed, key points, or hierarchical section-by-section summaries.

get.description: Retrieves or generates a default quick summary for a document.

post.description: Explains a selected passage simply, technically, or extracts key definitions.
Generates study flashcards, multiple-choice quizzes, key terms, or structured notes.

get.description: Generates an interactive quiz for document.
Extracts key terms and definitions from document.
